description: Moxa NPort 5610-16 16-port RS-232 rackmount serial device server. The front has an LCD panel, four push buttons and a Reset button. It also has the Ready, LAN and PWR lamps and a Tx and an Rx lamp for each serial port. The rear has a ground screw, an AC inlet with a rocker switch and one LAN jack. It also has 16 RJ45 serial ports in two groups of eight.

gaps.note: The data sheet lists WK-45-01 as two L-shaped plates, 8 screws, 45 x 57 x 2.5 mm. The quick installation guide calls the same kit a DIN-rail/wall kit. No guide is held, so no kit is written; the ears are stated as the CAD sheet draws them.
gaps.wanted: an installation guide for the rack-mounting kit WK-45-01 with its parts and the racks it takes.

gaps.note: The only colour is the data sheet's printed render of a DC model, which is not compared with a photograph.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the front and of the AC rear.

gaps.note: The lamps are drawn and labelled as the figure prints them. This order does not read the lamp tables of the NPort 5000 manual and states no lamp behaviour.
gaps.wanted: the quick installation guide's or the manual's table of what the Ready, Tx, Rx, LAN and PWR lamps show.

gaps.note: The rear figures draw it and no held document names it; it is not drawn.
gaps.wanted: a name for the small dot above the ground screw.

gaps.note: No held document announces or denies an end of life, and no source outside the held ones was looked at.
Data sheet page 4 gives 198.25 mm; the page 6 drawing and the CAD sheet give 197.85 and 194.25 mm and no 198.25. The text figure is used, and the sides and underside are read against it.

name: nport-5610-16

bottom.note: The sheet's underside view, rendered at 200 dpi: 440 mm is 1726 px, 3.92 px/mm, and the body is 760 px deep, 193.7 mm against the sheet's 194.25. Positions are read from the front edge of that view and put on the 198.25 mm face, so they are good to about 1 mm near the front edge. The body in that view is 4.5 mm shallower than the 198.25 mm face, so every position carries that gap at the rear: the two rear holes and the plate can sit up to about 4.5 mm further from the rear edge than the sheet draws them. The view is drawn with the front at the top, so it is turned to the library's underside, rear at the top and left and right mirrored. It shows four round holes 14.8 mm across, six tabs on the front edge at a 72.2 mm pitch and a plate near the rear with two screws and a tab. The sheet's coloured corner and edge marks are drawing marks and are not drawn. What the plate covers is not stated.

cad-drawing.note: The maker's 2D CAD sheet for the NPort 5650-16-T, 5610-16, 5630-16 and 5650-16 (one sheet, one title block for the four). It dimensions the body at 440.00 wide and 45.50 high and the top view at 197.85 and 194.25 deep, as the data sheet page 6 drawing does, so the body, the front, the rear and the top are the ones of the NPort 5650-16. It also draws the left and right sides, the underside and the ears, read below.

colour.note: The body and plate colours are read from the printed render on data sheet page 1, which shows a DC model and is not a calibrated photograph: a dark blue-grey front, a lighter end cap and a near-black rear. The line art of the guide draws the rear black. No photograph of the unit is held, so no colour is compared with one.

ears.note: The sheet's front view draws a flat ear on each end, the full height of the body, 481 mm over both ears at the sheet's scale, which agrees with the data sheet's 480 mm over the ears. Each ear has two slots 12.2 x 7.2 mm. The printed 31.80 is the distance between the two slot centres of an ear, and 457.00 and 468.20 are the spans between the slot end centres across the unit. The top view puts the back of the flange about 7.9 mm behind the front face, read at 400 dpi against the 440 mm width. The sheet's 57 mm plate at the front of each side view is read as the ear's own leg, so it is not drawn on the sides: the ear is stated as an ear position and drawn once, by that position, and not on any face.

front.note: Data sheet page 6, Standard Model and Wide Temp. Model front elevations, and quick installation guide page 2, 'Front panel of the NPort 5600 Series' (which prints 'NPort 5650-16'; this nameplate takes this model's number, an estimate). Left to right: end cap with the maker mark, the LCD panel, the Reset button, four push buttons, the nameplate, two rows of 16 lamps (Tx above Rx) under the port numerals, a Ready lamp, a LAN lamp and a PWR lamp. The window and push-button sizes are read off the line art; the lamps (2.0 mm) and the Reset button (4.0 mm) take the shared parts' sizes, and the rings the line art draws are larger. The lamp colours and what each lamp shows are not in a held document.

front-lamps.note: The 32 Tx and Rx lamps are in two rows in port order, but a lamp cannot name a port on the other face, so each lamp is `for: chassis` and its number is its id. Data sheet page 1 says the Tx/Rx lamps are for the serial ports.

ground.note: A round screw at the left end of the rear, in both rear figures and the data sheet's 'Ground' callout on page 2. Its size is not stated; the nominal unsized ground screw is placed. A small dot above it is drawn in the figure and not named.

lan.note: Data sheet page 2: one 10/100BaseT(X) RJ45 port with 1.5 kV magnetic isolation. The rear figures label it LAN. Data sheet page 1 says the Ethernet LEDs are 'located on the RJ45 connector', so the lamped Ethernet jack part is placed, although the line art draws no lamp on it.

power.note: Data sheet page 4: AC models 100 to 240 VAC, 47 to 63 Hz; input current 141 mA @ 100 VAC for the NPort 5610-16. The rear figures draw an IEC inlet with a rocker switch below it, labelled 'AC Power 100-240 VAC 47-63 Hz'. No held document states a power draw in watts, and a current is not converted to one.

ru.note: No held document states a rack-unit height. The data sheet says '19-inch rack mounting' and the rack kit plates are 45 mm high. The 45.5 mm body is taken as one rack unit.

scale.note: Every position is read off the page 6 'All Other Models' drawings of the data sheet, rendered at 600 dpi. The front and rear elevations are drawn to the 440 mm body: 1480 px across and 153 px high, 3.364 px/mm in both directions, so the figures pass the aspect check and carry geometry. Readings are good to about 0.5 mm. The top view is read from the same page at the same scale, y = 0 at the rear edge as the figure draws it.

serial-ports.note: Data sheet page 3: 16 ports on an 8-pin RJ45 for the NPort 5610 models, RS-232. The page 6 and guide page 2 rear figures draw two blocks of eight, numbered 1 to 8 and 9 to 16, with a ground-screw-like hole under the middle of each block. The jacks are placed at the registry's ganged pitch of 13.97 mm and the blocks are centred on the drawn frames: the drawn frame is 8 x 14.7 mm, wider than the jacks it holds, so the drawing is not read for a jack pitch. The jack's latch side is the line art's, up.

sides.note: The sheet's left and right views, rendered at 300 dpi: the body is 1163 px for 198.25 mm and 268 px for 45.5 mm, 5.87 and 5.89 px/mm. The sheet prints no hole position on a side, so every position is read at that scale and is good to about 1 mm; the hole sizes are read at the same scale. Each side shows at the front a plate 56.9 mm long with two rows of three holes at a 20.1 mm pitch and a fold at the front end. That plate is read as the rack ear's own leg: it matches the 57 mm leg of the L-shaped rack plates (45 x 57 mm) the data sheet lists on page 8, and a rack ear is drawn once, by the ear position, so the plate is not drawn on the side. Toward the rear each side shows two rows of two holes and one larger dot, and two small holes at the rear edge, which are drawn. The right side is the left one mirrored in depth. What the holes take (rivet nuts, screws or bare holes) is not stated, so they are drawn as holes.

size.note: Data sheet page 4, dimensions without ears for all models but the NPort 5650-8: 440 x 45.5 x 198.25 mm. The page 6 'All Other Models' drawing agrees on width 440 and height 45.5 and draws the depth as 197.85 and 194.25, without the 198.25 figure. The text figure is used, and the difference is the line art's. The 480 mm with-ears width is not used: the body is the metal between the ear folds.

sources.note: Two Moxa documents. NPort 5600 Series data sheet v1.9 (updated Aug 22, 2026): pages 1 to 3 (features, interfaces and serial ports), page 4 Physical Characteristics, Power Parameters and Environmental Limits, page 6 Dimensions, page 7 Ordering Information, page 8 Rack-Mounting Kits. NPort 5600 quick installation guide Version 5.4: page 2 Hardware Introduction with the front and rear panel figures. No photograph, stencil or CAD model is read.

top.note: Data sheet page 6, top view of the 'All Other Models' drawing: three sets of louvre openings and three screws along the front edge. Each set is one vent field, its openings read off the figure as polygons.
